rdfs:label: mbox_sha1sum
rdfs:comment: The SHA-1 hash of the agent's mailbox URI — a privacy-preserving inverse-functional identifier.
notes: Inverse-functional like `foaf:mbox` but doesn't reveal the actual email address. Compute the SHA-1 hex digest of the full `mailto:` URI string exactly as used in `foaf:mbox` (e.g. SHA-1 of `"mailto:alice@example.org"`); do not lowercase or otherwise normalise it. Two agents with the same `mbox_sha1sum` are the same agent. Modern profiles often skip both this and `mbox` for privacy.

history.note: Notes: hash the mailto: URI exactly, no lowercasing; example uses the real SHA-1 of mailto:alice@example.org.
